clips.title: Heading Out for Lunch in LA
grammar: 〜てくれる — doing something for someone
〜に行く — go in order to do

lines.en: Good morning! Hello everyone, I'm Yuna.

lines.en: Today, my boyfriend has come all the way from Japan to visit LA.
